craft_notes: Sthāyin: maṅgala bow (FIRST-VERSE voice: plain, declarative, end-weighted homage; sets house voice — owner verdict required). Sanskrit: prapañcottīrṇarūpāya namaste...svātmane'nantaśaktaye → L4 keeps bow-past-world-shining-self arc. Rows: row 2 (shining→bow). Close: bow (namas as landing, doubled). Rejected: 'worship' for homage — kept bow (namas as bending, not rite); 'transcendent' — kept past-the-world (uttīrṇa as crossed-beyond).

lines: Homage to the world-formed, past the world — to ever-shining divinity,
to self of unending power — I bow, I bow.

reads_against.argmap: What is first worshipped? → The maṅgala names its object twice: the formed world transcended, the shining self whose power does not end.
c1_essence: Homage to the world-formed beyond the world, ever-shining self of unending power.
